reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but duplicates transaction-download plumbing and the local clearing operation in unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The change duplicates both an existing provider downloader's request/response flow and unlinkAccount's account-field reset.

placement.why: Server responsibilities remain in the established modules, but the Fintegra model belongs in its own provider module and an assertion helper should not perform unlink mutations.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking policies, Fintegra integration, and related tests.

maintainability.why: Shared validation serves every provider, but its misleading assertion name, mutation responsibility, and duplicated unlink fields make future changes harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked reproduces unlinkAccount's local clearing operation; extract that operation so replacement can reuse it without provider cleanup.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing downloadEnableBankingTransactions request/error/response flow into compact expressions and a retVal variable rather than sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: the shared duplicate-link assertion gains replaceExistingLink, closed-account rejection, and a replacement branch that mutates another account; all six provider handlers call it.
